items.title: Senior Support Specialist, Ads
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team ensures that our customers’ experience is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide guidance, and support customers in maximizing value with our products. Within User Operations, Ads Safety Operations helps OpenAI grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable for advertisers, users and the business. The Ads Safety Support team sits within Ads Safety Operations and owns the advertiser-facing support journey: helping advertisers navigate ads products, policies, reviews, and enforcement decisions while turning frontline insights into better guidance, tooling, and product experiences. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Advertiser Support Specialist to help build and scale advertiser support within Ads Safety Operations. You’ll work directly with advertisers through support tickets, escalations, owning high-impact questions related to ads policies, review outcomes, product behavior, and operational processes. Many cases will be novel or ambiguous, and you’ll be expected to investigate carefully, communicate clearly, and drive them to resolution in a fast-moving product environment. As OpenAI’s advertising ecosystem grows, your work will help advertisers operate successfully at scale while serving as a critical bridge between frontline support and the teams responsible for product quality, policy integrity, and platform safety. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native environment. You’ll turn support interactions into operational intelligence, identifying recurring friction, gaps in guidance, and emerging issues to improve support at scale, and protect the quality and safety of OpenAI’s ad ecosystem. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Policy, Legal and Go To Market partners to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale. In this role, you will: - Own advertiser cases from initial intake through resolution, including complex or sensitive Ads Trust & Safety escalations; investigate whether issues stem from policy, review operations, product behavior, tooling, or another dependency, then communicate clear next steps and follow through. - Develop deep expertise across advertiser workflows, ads policies, enforcement processes, review systems, and support tooling. - Build a detailed view of advertiser friction by combining ticket themes, escalation patterns, quality findings, and service metrics to prioritize improvements and identify emerging experience or safety gaps. - Turn frontline learnings into clearer help content, stronger playbooks, better routing and escalation criteria, improved knowledge management and quality standards, and self-service opportunities. - Partner with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Data Science, and Go To Market teams to resolve recurring issues, surface advertiser feedback, and scale durable solutions. - Drive operational excellence through AI-assisted workflows and automation that reduce manual effort, improve team efficiency, and elevate support quality. - Support readiness for new ads formats, features, and markets by anticipating advertiser questions and identifying support risks early. - Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 6+ years of experience in customer support, user operations, ads operations, Trust & Safety, risk operations, escalations, or a related field, including ownership of high-impact customer or advertiser cases. - Bring strong investigative judgment and can translate ambiguous signals into policy support, operational gaps, product defects, and expected behavior - Can synthesize data trends, feedback, QA findings, and service metrics into clear priorities and system improvement while maintaining strong judgment and safeguards - Have improved support processes, knowledge bases, escalation workflows, routing systems, or quality programs. - Are comfortable using AI and emerging technologies (i.e. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) and/or code (e.g. Python) to automate repetitive tasks and integrating tools - Build trust with cross-functional partners, communicate clearly and empathetically with advertisers and internal teams, and drive action without formal authority. - Thrive in ambiguity, learn quickly, manage competing priorities, and bring a humble, service-oriented mindset. - Bonus: Understand advertiser workflows, ads ecosystems, policy enforcement, account reviews, or ads safety operations. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

Our teams build the product experiences and platform foundations behind ChatGPT, Codex, our API platform, and offerings for businesses, enterprises, educational institutions, and other customers. Financial Engineering powers how customers purchase, access, and pay for these products. We build the systems behind pricing and packaging, checkout, payments, subscriptions, usage-based billing, credits, entitlements, invoicing, and the broader order-to-cash lifecycle. Our work spans consumer subscriptions, self-serve businesses, sophisticated enterprise agreements, developer usage, and emerging monetization models. These systems sit at the intersection of product experience and financial infrastructure. They must make it easy for customers to adopt OpenAI products while maintaining strong guarantees around correctness, reliability, security, reconciliation, and auditability. We partner closely with Product, Data Science, Finance, Accounting, Risk, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams to launch new offerings and build a financial platform that can evolve with OpenAI’s rapidly growing product portfolio. We are looking for an experienced engineer to help architect and build the next generation of these systems. In this role, you will: - Have 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform, or distributed systems. - Have strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, storage systems, transactional workflows, and event-driven architecture. - Have experience building systems where correctness, reliability, observability, security, or data integrity are especially important. - Are comfortable owning ambiguous, business-critical problems from initial definition through launch and long-term operation. - Bring a product-oriented mindset and care about creating simple, trustworthy experiences for both external customers and internal users. - Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners and enjoy working closely with Product, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Data, and Go-to-Market teams. - Make thoughtful tradeoffs between near-term delivery and long-term system quality. - Move quickly and independently in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities compete, and the right solution is not always obvious. Nice to Have: - Experience with payments, subscriptions, billing, pricing, credits, entitlements, invoicing, revenue systems, or other monetization infrastructure. - Experience with high-scale financial or transactional systems, reconciliation workflows, compliance requirements, or audit controls. - Experience building shared platforms, APIs, frameworks, or developer tools used by multiple product teams. items.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Services
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE The exchange is the core of what Polymarket does. Every trade, every order, every market resolution runs through the systems this team owns. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Services team, you'll be working directly on that infrastructure, building and scaling the backend that processes real money, in real time, at meaningful volume. The work is technical, high-stakes, and unambiguous in its consequences. This is an individual contributor role with high autonomy and high ownership. You'll work alongside a small group of senior engineers who care deeply about correctness and performance. There's no heavy process here, no committees, no long approval chains. You'll be expected to identify problems, propose solutions, and ship them. The mandate is simple: keep the exchange fast, correct, and available as Polymarket continues to scale. If you've spent your career building systems where performance actually matters, where a bug in production has real consequences, this is the kind of problem you've been waiting to work on. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and implement low-latency backend services that power Polymarket's core exchange, primarily in Go, with Python or Java where appropriate. - Profile and tune systems across the full stack, identifying bottlenecks in latency, throughput, and memory usage before they become production problems. - Build and maintain event-driven data pipelines and APIs using streaming platforms like Kafka or Pulsar, ensuring data moves reliably and quickly across the exchange. - Own production reliability for the systems you build, including diagnosing live incidents, writing postmortems, and shipping fixes that prevent recurrence. - Work directly with engineers across product, infrastructure, and data to integrate exchange services tightly with the broader platform. - Contribute to architectural decisions on distributed systems design, with a focus on failure modes, graceful degradation, and recovery under partial outages. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4 to 7+ years of professional backend development experience, with strong proficiency in Go, Python, or Java. Go experience is a significant advantage. - Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and memory management, with a track record of applying that knowledge to real production systems. - Experience building and debugging high-throughput, low-latency systems on Linux end-to-end, from design through to production operation. - Strong instincts for correctness, especially in systems where failures have financial consequences. You write defensively, think about edge cases early, and treat bugs in prod as a serious matter. - Comfortable working independently in a high-autonomy environment. You identify what needs to be done and do it without waiting to be unblocked. - (Plus) Experience in trading systems, high-frequency trading, gaming, telecom, or any domain where latency is a hard constraint, not a stretch goal. - (Plus) Production experience with Kafka, Pulsar, or similar streaming platforms at meaningful scale. - (Plus) Familiarity with gRPC, Protobuf, or ZeroMQ. - (Plus) Experience deploying and operating services in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, using containers and modern deployment tooling. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: Legal Specialist, Law Enforcement
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are looking for a hands-on Legal Specialist (Law Enforcement) to join our Litigation, Regulatory & Policy team at Anthropic. In this role, you will be a key player in building out our legal function and running how Anthropic responds to law enforcement and government requests for user data, while navigating the intricate regulatory landscape of the AI industry. We expect this role to flex beyond the law enforcement queue into legal operations to support the broader litigation, regulatory, and policy team. The successful candidate will be a strong team player, able to build positive relationships with colleagues and work collaboratively toward shared goals. Key responsibilities Own the end-to-end response to law enforcement and government requests for user data, from intake and validation through production and closeout, including subpoenas, court orders, search warrants, preservation letters, and emergency disclosure requests from domestic and foreign authorities Prepare and execute data productions: scoping, data retrieval, coordination with counsel, and eventual production Handle foreign and cross-border process, including MLATs and letters rogatory, and manage escalations across jurisdictions Handle civil third-party subpoenas and preservation demands Maintain expertise in where user data lives across Anthropic's product surfaces and operate the internal data retrieval tooling Run and improve the law enforcement response process and tooling Partner with Trust and Safety, Security, Privacy, and Engineering on requests that touch user accounts, investigations, or safety escalations Coordinate with outside counsel, alongside in-house counsel, on objections, challenges, and narrowing Produce recurring reporting on request volume, deadlines, and queue health, and support Anthropic's periodic transparency reporting on government requests Monitor legal developments in government access to user data and advise the team on their operational impact Support litigation and regulatory matters and stretch beyond core responsibilities as needed to support the legal team's objectives Minimum qualifications Experience in a legal operations, business/operations manager, or paralegal role in an in-house legal department, or similar experience Direct, front-line experience handling law enforcement or government requests for user data, including subpoenas, court orders, warrants, preservation letters, and emergency disclosure requests Working knowledge of the legal framework for law enforcement access to user data, including the Stored Communications Act and the mechanics of foreign and cross-border requests such as MLATs Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues at all levels of the organization Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment and maintain the highest standards of discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive legal matters, including under time pressure Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously Experience owning an intake, queue, or docketing process end to end, including deciding what gets escalated and maintaining rigorous tracking Comfort operating and improving the tooling a legal process runs on (trackers, spreadsheets, forms, aliases, and simple automations), with a willingness to make changes directly rather than route every change to someone else A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying, recommending, and implementing process improvements within the legal department Preferred qualifications 5+ years of experience in legal operations, business/operations management, or a paralegal role in an in-house legal department 2+ years of experience at a high-growth technology company, with exposure to the legal challenges and opportunities presented by emerging technologies Experience building or scaling a law enforcement response process Experience managing legal intake process within a growing company Demonstrated ability to think critically and creatively, adapting to new challenges and finding practical solutions to complex legal issues Familiarity with legal project management software such as Asana, Trello, or Jira, and a willingness to learn and adopt new tools to streamline legal processes The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $170,000 — $220,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: About the Team At OpenAI, Trust & Safety Operations is central to protecting OpenAI’s platform, customers, and the public from abuse. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Policy and Go To Market teams to identify emerging risks, build and mature enforcement systems, and ensure high-integrity operations while delivering a great user experience at scale. We’re building the Monetization Trust & Safety Operations team to ensure OpenAI can grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable—for users, advertisers, and the business. This team sits at the intersection of operational scale, product risk, and rapid revenue growth, designing systems and operations that enable ads to scale without compromising user trust or safety. It’s critical to us that our Ads product be built in a way that corresponds to our Ads principles https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fopenai%2Ecom%2Findex%2Four-approach-to-advertising-and-expanding-access%2F&urlhash=tnG4&isSdui=true, and this team is key to that. About the Role We’re looking for a senior operator to help build and scale Monetization Trust & Safety Operations at OpenAI. In this role, you’ll own critical Ads T&S workstreams from problem framing through scaled operation, partnering closely with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, and Go To Market to turn ambiguous priorities into durable operating models. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you’ll define scope, align owners, manage milestones and risks, resolve dependencies, and build the workflows, decision structures, and operating mechanisms that allow Ads Trust & Safety to scale. You’ll move between standing up new programs, stabilizing existing workflows, and handing off durable ownership as priorities evolve. As OpenAI introduces new revenue-generating formats and partnerships, you’ll bring structure to complex initiatives that balance user safety, advertiser experience, and business growth. You’ll use data and frontline signals to identify bottlenecks, quality gaps, capacity needs, and high-leverage interventions, and communicate clear recommendations and tradeoffs to cross-functional partners and leadership. In this role, you will: - Own complex, high-impact Ads Trust & Safety programs from problem framing through launch, stabilization, and scaled operation. - Define program scope, owners, milestones, risks, success measures, and execution cadence for strategic operational builds. - Translate policy, risk, technical, legal, and operational constraints into workflows, requirements, playbooks, escalation paths, and decision structures. - Coordinate across Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Go To Market, Support, vendors, and other partners to resolve dependencies and keep critical work moving. - Move flexibly across priorities—standing up new programs, improving existing workflows, strengthening handoffs, and transitioning durable ownership to the right teams. - Use operational data and frontline signals to identify bottlenecks, quality gaps, capacity needs, ownership failures, and the highest-leverage interventions. - Drive high-priority escalations and cross-functional decisions to closure with clear context, accountable owners, next steps, and durable follow-through. - Create program mechanisms that make operations run well, including roadmaps, decision logs, status updates, risk registers, operating reviews, and executive communication. - Identify where AI tools, automation, lightweight systems, or simpler workflows can improve speed, consistency, and scale while preserving appropriate human judgment. You might thrive in this role if you: - 8+ years of experience in program management, strategy and operations, product operations, technical program management, Trust & Safety, Risk Operations, Ads or Monetization Operations, or a related field. - Deep familiarity with ads ecosystems, advertiser risk, or high-stakes scaled operations. - Proven ability to take complex, ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem framing through launch and scaled operation. - Strong organizational and execution skills; able to manage many moving pieces while staying focused on the decisions and risks that matter most. - Strong operational judgment and systems thinking—able to design operating models that scale beyond manual review. - Experience building trust and driving alignment across Product, Policy, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Support, vendors, and other partners without direct authority. - Comfort using data and operational metrics to identify bottlenecks, prioritize work, measure impact, and inform tradeoffs. - Technical and analytical fluency to reason about dashboards, data flows, tooling gaps, automation, and failure modes, even if you are not writing production code. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex risk tradeoffs, decisions, and incomplete evidence to operational, technical, policy, and executive audiences. - Experience with launch readiness, QA programs, workflow automation, vendor operations, or AI-assisted operations, with strong judgment around safeguards and responsible deployment. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: Product Marketing Manager, Advertising & Engagement
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com About this role - Product Marketing Manager, Advertising & Engagement Genius Sports is evolving from a technology and services business into a more product-led organization. Within Advertising & Engagement, that means helping the market understand the breadth and value of our advertising portfolio — from official live data and fan identity to real-time activation products like Genius Sports Moments. This is one of the fastest-moving parts of our business: our Moment Engine now integrates with partners representing roughly 90% of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, and adoption is accelerating around tentpole moments like the Super Bowl, the NBA Finals and the FIFA World Cup. We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Advertising & Engagement to help shape, launch and grow our advertising technology portfolio. This is a high-impact role within one of Genius Sports' most strategically important and fastest-growing business areas, working closely with Product, Marketing, Commercial and Revenue teams to bring complex advertising products to market in a clear, compelling and commercially effective way. This role is ideal for a B2B product marketer who enjoys turning complex technology into sharp positioning, clear sales narratives and practical go-to-market plans. You will support the Advertising & Engagement marketing leadership while owning important workstreams across product launches, sales enablement, customer insight, product adoption and market positioning. You will play a central role in helping Genius Sports tell a stronger Advertising & Engagement story: not just as a trusted provider of official sports data, but as the execution layer connecting live sports data directly to real-time advertising activation — helping brands, agencies, broadcasters and platforms move from scheduled campaigns to always-on, moment-driven advertising. Responsibilities Product positioning and messaging Develop clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for Genius Sports' Advertising & Engagement products, translating technical capabilities into customer-centric value propositions. Build messaging frameworks that help Product, Commercial and Marketing teams consistently explain what our products do, who they are for, why they matter and how they compare in market. Help sharpen Genius Sports' advertising narrative around real-time activation, official data, fan identity and AI-powered decisioning — shifting the category conversation from scheduled media to moment-driven engagement. Go-to-market planning and product launches Own and support GTM plans for key Advertising & Engagement product launches, releases and strategic packages, including new capabilities, integrations and partnerships. Work with Product, Commercial and Marketing teams to define target audiences, customer pain points, launch objectives, timelines, KPIs, sales motions, collateral needs and campaign requirements. Sequence launches and campaigns against the global sports calendar, supporting major product and market moments including tentpole events like the Super Bowl, NBA Finals and FIFA World Cup, new season activity, and flagship industry events such as NewFronts. Sales enablement and commercial support Create foundational sales enablement materials that help Commercial teams confidently sell complex advertising and engagement products. Work with our Sales Marketing team to build sales decks, one-pagers, battlecards, product narratives, FAQs, internal briefings and training materials for audiences including brands, agencies, broadcasters, SSPs and demand platforms. Run product training and enablement sessions for Commercial teams, ensuring sales teams understand new products, releases, positioning and proof points. Partner with Commercial stakeholders to understand barriers to adoption or deal progression, then create tools and messaging that help overcome them. Customer insight and market understanding Build a strong understanding of advertisers, agencies, broadcasters, programmatic platforms, market trends and the competitive landscape across sports adtech. Conduct and synthesize customer interviews, sales feedback, surveys and market research to inform product positioning, messaging and GTM strategy. Act as a customer and market voice within the Marketing team, helping ensure campaigns and collateral reflect real advertiser and agency needs and buying drivers. Product adoption and release communication Improve how new Advertising & Engagement products, features and releases are communicated internally and externally. Work with Product and Commercial teams to ensure important product updates, including expanding Moment Engine integrations, are understood, adopted and commercialized effectively. Support stronger customer education and product utilization by creating clearer communications, launch materials and adoption-focused messaging. Product expertise and cross-functional influence Develop a deep understanding of Genius Sports' Advertising & Engagement portfolio, where products create value, how they are sold, and how they compare to competitors. Build strong relationships across Product, Marketing, Commercial, Revenue, Data and Partnerships teams. Contribute upstream in the product development process by helping shape target audiences, value propositions, product packaging, naming, messaging, and launch readiness. Evidence, reporting and thought leadership Help build a stronger repository of case studies, customer proof points, product performance stories, and launch reports — including brand recall and campaign performance evidence from real-time activation. Work with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to identify customer success stories and turn them into compelling collateral, campaign content and thought leadership. Support post-launch and post-event reporting to show product impact, customer adoption, and commercial value. Qualifications 3–5 years' experience in B2B product marketing, product-led marketing, commercial marketing, or a related role. Experience working in adtech, martech, programmatic advertising, media, fan engagement or sports technology. A strong storyteller who can simplify complex products and turn technical detail into clear, commercially compelling messaging. Experience developing product positioning, value propositions, launch plans, sales collateral and enablement materials. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present to internal teams and act as a product evangelist. Commercially minded, with an understanding of how marketing supports revenue, product adoption, and customer growth. Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing and Revenue teams. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams across launches, campaigns, and stakeholder groups. Curious, proactive, and comfortable getting into the detail of technical products, customer needs and market dynamics. The annualized base salary for this role ranges from $120,000 to $160,000 USD and includes eligibility for additional variable compensation and equity. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. Occasional travel may be required. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports. Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

items.title: Reseller Enablement Lead
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the team Within GTM, the Partner Enablement team builds the programs, credentials, and learning infrastructure that allow Anthropic's ecosystem of system integrators, cloud providers, resellers, and technology partners to build deep Claude expertise and deliver successful customer outcomes at scale. We work cross-functionally across Partnerships, Sales, Applied AI, Product, Marketing, and Legal to make sure partner-facing programs are clear, consistent, and high-impact. About the role Anthropic is launching a global reseller program, and we are looking for a Reseller Enablement Lead to build the enablement motion that makes it work. You will design and launch reseller certification, training, and readiness programs alongside the program itself, starting in our first launch markets and scaling globally from there. This is a build-and-run role. In the first months you will stand up the foundation from scratch: what a reseller needs to know to sell Claude well, how we certify that they know it, and how we deliver that across markets and languages. From there, you will own the motion as it grows, evolving content and modalities as the program's commercial structure matures, localizing for new regions, and using enablement to keep partner behavior aligned with how we want Claude sold. You will be the single global owner for reseller enablement, scaling delivery through training networks rather than a large direct team. This is a highly cross-functional role working closely with Partnerships, Partner Programs, Partner Operations, Sales, Applied AI, and Certification to ensure reseller-facing programs land clearly and drive measurable outcomes. Responsibilities Define and own Anthropic's reseller enablement strategy, from launch in initial markets through global rollout Own delivery of the message you build: present and deliver training directly to reseller sellers and leaders, and activate training partners so they carry it consistently at scale Build the reseller curriculum and certification path from the ground up, covering commercial mechanics, program rules, platform and product fundamentals, and responsible use Design repeatable programs across partner onboarding, sales readiness, recertification, and product launches, choosing modalities that fit how reseller sellers actually learn and what motivates them Stand up localized delivery in launch markets, then extend the model to new regions through training networks and regional enablement teams Work closely with Applied AI to translate technical concepts into clear, digestible content on Anthropic's models and products for a seller audience Evolve enablement as the program evolves, keeping content current with changes to commercial structure, transaction rails, and program requirements Use enablement as a governance lever, building content and reinforcement that keeps partner selling behavior on program and addresses drift when it appears Enable Anthropic sellers and partner managers to co-sell and engage effectively with resellers Partner cross-functionally with Partner Programs, Partner Operations, and Sales to align priorities and ensure consistent execution Establish metrics and reporting to track reseller certification, activation, and contribution to registered pipeline and consumption Build feedback loops that bring reseller insights back into program design, enablement, and GTM strategy You may be a good fit if you Have 7-10+ years of experience across partner enablement, partner programs, product marketing, with a clear track record of designing and owning programs end to end. Channel and Alliances experience is key, but must be accompanied with demonstrated program ownership. Understand how resell and channel ecosystems work commercially, including deal registration, margin and rebate structures, partner tiering, and cloud marketplace motions Have built and scaled partner enablement or certification programs from nothing to something in a high-growth technology environment Think operationally and in systems, designing for scale across regions and languages rather than one-off efforts Understand how to package enablement: which modality fits which audience, what motivates partner sellers, and how to structure a curriculum that produces real selling capability Are a strong presenter and facilitator, able to deliver training credibly to partner audiences and equip others to deliver it the same way Combine leadership and hands-on execution, equally comfortable setting strategy with executives and building the first version of a course yourself Bring executive presence with partner and internal leadership, and the scrappiness to get things done in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment Are an effective cross-functional operator who can drive alignment across complex organizations Strong candidates may also have Experience launching programs in a single region and then scaling them globally, including localization and in-market delivery Experience building or running an authorized training partner or certified instructor network Prior ownership of, or close partnership with, a technology certification program Experience with resell motions in Japan, Korea, or other reseller-led markets A track record connecting enablement activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes Logistics This role is based in London. We operate a hybrid model and expect regular time onsite with partners and at Anthropic offices. Expect roughly 30-35% travel, concentrated around launch windows and launch regions. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £160,000 — £215,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. This role is remote and can be executed across EMEA. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London or Warsaw. ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is a research and product company defining the frontier of Audio AI. Millions of individuals use ElevenLabs to read articles, voice over their videos, and reclaim voices lost from disability. And the leading developers and enterprises use ElevenLabs to create Conversational AI agents for support, sales, and education. ElevenLabs launched in January 2023 with the first AI model to cross the threshold of human-like speech. In January 2025, we raised a $180 million Series C round, valuing ElevenLabs at $3.3 billion. The round was co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and ICONIQ Growth, with continued support from the leading names in tech, including Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Instagram co-founder Mike Krieger, Oculus VR co-founder Brendan Iribe, DeepMind and Inflection co-founder Mustafa Suleyman, and many others. ElevenLabs is only 2 years old and scaling rapidly. We are just getting started. If you want to work hard and have an incredible impact, we would love to hear from you. WHAT WE OFFER - Learning & development: Annual discretionary stipend towards professional development. - Social travel: Annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: We bring the entire company together at a new location every year. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. ABOUT THE ROLE - Be part of an early CS team with endless opportunities for impact . You’ll partner with the CS team to help develop a scalable CS playbook and framework that supports our customers in EMEA. - Build, maintain and own strong relationships with a book of 40-50 enterprise clients. - Play a key role in onboarding new clients and driving long term adoption of multiple products. - Monitor customer usage and adoption of our products to identify areas for improvement or revenue expansion. - Own expansion and renewal of accounts within your book of business - this is a commercial role. - Own your customer success KPIs (NRR/GRR) and contribute to CS OKR goals. REQUIREMENTS - 5-7 years of previous experience in Customer Success in a fast paced, SaaS organisation. - Experience demonstrating and unlocking value for customers with technical, mission critical products (such as conversational AI). - Commercial experience - you will own renewals and expansion for your book of business, driving towards best in class NRR results. - Demonstrates a strong builder mindset with a relentless focus on customer excellence and scalable product solutions. - Exceptional communicator with the ability to establish, nurture, and maintain relationships across all levels of customer organizations, including complex stakeholder environments. - Strong analytical thinker and creative problem-solving skills to address diverse customer challenges and drive optimal outcomes. - Must be fluent in English - additional languages are a plus. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
